description: PRIMARY EDIT TOOL. Run a natural-language video edit end-to-end. The backend agent plans, executes, verifies, and exports. Accepts anything from a one-liner ("generate 3 viral clips with captions and export") to a multi-paragraph creative brief. Returns the final mp4 URL synchronously when an export is queued. For long renders you may prefer queue_edit + check_job_status.

assets.description: Optional input media assets. URLs must be public HTTP/HTTPS links.

url.description: Publicly accessible HTTP/HTTPS URL to the video, image, or audio asset.

attachedImages.description: Optional reference image URLs used for planning.

brandId.description: Optional per-call brand profile id (brand kits are managed in the Levea studio or with the MCP server's brand-kit tools).

captionTemplatePreset.description: Optional caption template to apply when (re)generating captions: a builtin slug (e.g. hormozi, mrbeast, viral-pop, karaoke, neon-pop, subtitle-bar) or a user-saved template id. With the MCP server, list_caption_templates lists the exact ids.

core_only.description: Return rendering-essential scene fields only (smaller payloads).

editedPlan.description: Optional pre-edited plan object returned by a prior awaiting_approval response.

flaggedIssues.description: Optional list of specific user-flagged problems for this run (e.g. ["caption #3 misspelled"]).

planDecision.description: Typed approval of a plan returned by an awaiting_approval response. Send "approve" together with the workingMemory (and optionally editedPlan) from that response to run the plan as proposed. Omit it to revise the plan with a new prompt instead.

projectBrandId.description: Optional default brand for the project. Persists; per-call brandId overrides.

project_id.description: Optional project id for tracking and continuity. Reuse the projectId returned by the first call for every continuation.

prompt.description: Natural-language description of the desired edit or creative brief. The backend planner decomposes it into canonical actions (viral clips, captions, reframe, export, …). Send the user's intent verbatim — do not pre-decompose.

requirePlanApproval.description: If true, the backend stops after planning and returns workingMemory for user approval. Resend with workingMemory (and optionally editedPlan) to continue.

scene.description: Optional existing scene/timeline state to continue editing (advanced).

video_url.description: Optional public source video URL (HTTP/HTTPS: S3, Google Drive public link, Dropbox, direct MP4) for a new project. Local file paths are not supported.

workingMemory.description: Working memory returned by an awaiting-approval call; resend it to resume.

name: autonomous_edit
title: Edit video
